security_surfaces: Auth pattern quan sat duoc: Laravel Sanctum SPA cookie-session (__Secure-teeinblue_staging_session, HttpOnly, khong xuat hien trong request_headers cua cac capture) + CSRF double-submit qua cookie XSRF-TOKEN / header x-xsrf-token cho MOI request POST/PUT/DELETE va MOI GraphQL mutation. Header x-acting-user-id (gia tri so, khong phai PII) xuat hien tren cac call state-changing.

GraphQL endpoint (POST /api/graphql) dung chung 1 URL cho ca query va mutation, phan biet qua operationName + noi dung 'query' string (khong co REST-style path rieng cho tung resource) - pattern giong Hasura (ten kieu 'products_by_pk', 'insert_x_objects').

Upload flow 2 buoc: (1) POST /api/users/{userId}/temporary-files/upload-url tra ve presigned PUT URL (AWS SigV4, TTL ngan quan sat duoc 299-300s) toi object storage rieng (oe-cdn.sgp1.digitaloceanspaces.com), (2) client PUT truc tiep file len storage do (khong qua app backend), (3) POST /api/mockup-layers/by-temporary-file de dang ky metadata. Presigned URL la co che chuan, khong phai secret ro (het han nhanh).

PHAT HIEN CAN CHU Y (khong thuoc quyen sua cua api-explorer): cac file raw/network/ACT-08-RC2-010-logs-page.json va raw/network/ACT-04-RC2-LOG-create-printarea-and-check-logs.json (va co the ca file khac) chua GIA TRI THAT (chua redact) cua header 'x-xsrf-token' trong request_headers cua nhieu entry (vi du: GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie, POST /api/users/.../upload-url, POST /api/mockup-layers/by-temporary-file, POST /api/staff-activity-logs/printarea). Gia tri KHONG duoc copy vao artifact nay (chi ghi 'value redacted' trong auth.headers_observed). Day la finding ve VI PHAM redaction o RAW EVIDENCE cua portal-explorer (ngoai write scope cua api-explorer, chi co the ghi nhan va bao cho orchestrator) - can 1 luot redact lai raw/network/ truoc khi publish hoac chia se rong hon.
